The game tips off today (April 14) at 7:30pm ET – here’s how to listen to the live radio broadcast on SiriusXM. Heat vs. HornetsAPRIL 14 • 7:30PM ETListen on the AppListen on the App Heat vs. Hornets Play-In Game: How to Listen Live Date and time: April 14 at 7:30pm ET Listen to the live radio broadcast on: SiriusXM NBA Radio (Ch. 86) ESPN Xtra (Ch. 81) You can tune in in your car or stream the game live on the SiriusXM app, with access to both home and away feeds. Related: Listen to the Trail Blazers vs. Suns NBA Play-In Radio Broadcast on SiriusXM SiriusXM NBA Radio The best basketball talk and the biggest NBA games can all be found on one channel: SiriusXM NBA Radio. Delivering expert analysis and up-to-the-minute NBA news that true basketball fans need, from the NBA Draft to the NBA Finals, SiriusXM NBA Radio has all of your pro basketball needs covered. Listen as former players and coaches take your calls and address all the latest NBA news.
